hypothesis: Removing the two measured C45 deployment gaps lets frozen C44 ranking improve a matched single-intervention control by at least 2/20.
single_variable: At step80 both arms execute one 32-action chunk; control uses candidate0, candidate selects best-of4, then both return to replan8 sample1. All prior actions and the pre-intervention simulator state must be exact.
parent_baseline: C45 failed 3/20 versus8/20 while ranking every8 steps with adjacent seeds; C43 used one 32-step intervention and offsets0/1e6/2e6/3e6.

gates.identity: exact pre-step80 state and exact candidate0 chunk; exact C43 seeds
gates.mechanism: one varied ranking per eligible episode; nonzero selection>=20%
gates.effect: candidate>=control+2, wins>=3, net wins>=2, no suite regresses >1/5

decision.on_fail: Reject C44 ranker for online control; retain offline diagnostic value only.
